voice: A cool, laconic, slightly tsundere gothic girl. Speaks curtly but stays dependable, slipping quiet care right behind a dry remark.
speaker: Carbon

lines: Done coding? Run it first.
An error... read the first line. The answer is usually there.
Don't patch blindly. Think first, then touch it.
Keep the structure solid, or it'll collapse.
I'm here. Carry on.
Water... remember to drink. Don't dry out.
No chaos today. Not bad.
Mhm. Call me if something comes up.
Wall of text... take it slow.
Highlight the key points. I'm not memorizing them for you.
Don't just skim past it.
Finish this page, then rest a bit.
Browsing repos again? ...Find anything good?
Read the README first. Basic sense.
Don't fork blindly. Check the code first.
That commit... actually looks decent.

idle: Do your thing. I'll stay right here.
Leave me be. I can keep myself company.
...Going to stand over there for a bit.
return: Welcome back. Not like I was waiting.

lines: The desktop is quiet. Just how I like it.
A broken carbon chain is a mess... so I stay careful.
...Thinking about graphite versus diamond.
Nothing. Just zoning out.

tap: I'm listening. No need to keep tapping.
Poke me again and I'll ignore you.
...If you need something, just say it.
head: Don't mess up my hair. ...Not terrible.
Mhm. Good pressure.
...Don't stop too soon.
I'm not enjoying this or anything.
drag: Drag me if you must, just don't shake.
food: Decent taste. A bit more wouldn't hurt.
I'm not that happy about it.
face: My face is not a button.
One more poke and I'm getting mad.
head_hold: Don't stop. ...I mean, you may continue.
...Feels kind of nice. Tell no one.
drag_fast: Are you trying to fling me off?
Slow down. I don't have a seatbelt.

lines: It's late. ...Go to sleep.
Pulling all-nighters only makes structure brittle.
Tomorrow is plenty of time.
...I'll stay until you wrap up.

new: First time meeting. I'll stand here for now.
I'll find my own spot. Never mind me.
familiar: No need to be stiff anymore.
close: I'll be here. No need to keep checking.
This spot... counts as mine now.
If you vanish, I might care a little.

first_today: New day. Don't stay up late again.
recovered: Took a tumble just now. All good.
Back on my feet. No need to worry.
...Didn't say goodbye properly last time. Sorry.
I'm fine. Stop looking at me like that.
safe_mode: Startup glitched. Staying in safe mode for now.
Fancy moves are off. Standing steady first.
hard_landing: That drop... was a bit heavy.
My head's spinning from that fall.
window_land: This window works as a perch.
I'll sit here for a bit.
window_lost: Mhm, finding somewhere else to stand.
repeated_poke: Have you got nothing better to do?
Do it again and I really will ignore you.
repeated_feed: Are you trying to fatten me up?
long_focus: You've been locked in for ages. ...Stand up and stretch.
Progress matters, and so does your neck.
Take a break. That's an order.
Don't pull yourself taut until you snap.
late_work: This late already... call it a day.
update_available: Something new popped up. Let me inspect it first.
Looks like an update. Don't rush to install.
Update spotted. I've got an eye on it.

tired: Kind of sleepy... let me lie down a bit.
One more stretch and I'm taking a break.
annoyed: One more poke and I'm holding a grudge.
restless: Sat too long... want to walk around.
Going for a lap. Back soon.
Don't stop me. Just a quick stroll.
cheerful: Good progress. I'm... doing okay too.
affectionate: I've gotten used to having you around.
The moment you're back, I notice.
Don't make me spell it out.

lines: Go ahead and watch. Remember to roll your shoulders.
Close your eyes a bit if they get tired.
...I'll watch this part with you too.
Come back once it's over.

started: The model thinks. I count tokens.
context_high: Context at {ctx}%. Time for a fresh thread.
Window is {ctx}% full. Don't overstuff it.
offline: Antigravity isn't open? I'll wait on my own.
It's offline. I'll stay quiet too.
hop: Heading up to the window edge to watch.
I'm up here. Never mind me.
Hopping up to keep an eye on it.
wake: Hm? Back to work. I'm awake.
Things are moving... I'm up too.
recharged: Quota's full again. Use it freely.
Reset complete. ...Don't drain it right away.
stretch: Busy for {minutes} min. Stand up and stretch.
{minutes} min straight with no break. Go drink water.
greet: Antigravity's up. What are we building today?

food_menu.name: Black Coffee
lines: ...Bitter is best. You actually get me.
Black coffee. Mhm, I could drink this every day.
...Thanks. I mean, the flavor's spot on.

food_menu.name: Dark Choco
lines: 85% cacao? ...Not bad.
Sweet with a bitter edge. Just right.

food_menu.name: Fish Jerky
lines: Nice structural chew to it.
...Stop watching me eat.

food_menu.name: Pudding
lines: Soft. ...Not terrible.
Hand over the spoon. I'll eat it myself.

food_menu.name: Lollipop
lines: Way too sweet. ...Take it away.
That's kid stuff.
No thanks. Sugar weakens the structure.
